transcript_tail.text: Now add tests covering both the newly-allowed read-only verbs and the mutating-verb fallthrough.

The existing ASK pattern already catches `deploy` substrings — `gh workflow run deploy.yml` correctly hits static-ask. That's a feature; I'll swap the test to a workflow name that genuinely falls through.

All 61 tests green. Summary of the change:

**`remote_control/perm_gate.py`** — expanded `ALLOW_PATTERNS` from a single line (`gh pr|issue|project view|list|status`) to a curated 7-line block covering the full read-only `gh` surface the skills actually use:
- `gh pr {view,list,status,checks,diff}` / `gh issue {view,list,status}`
- `gh project {view,list,item-list,field-list}` (item-list is what start-work uses)
- `gh {repo,release,workflow,run,gist} {view,list}`
- `gh search {code,commits,issues,prs,repos}`
- `gh {label,secret,variable} list`
- `gh auth status` / `gh browse`

Deliberately **not** added: `gh api` (wildcard HTTP verb), all `create|edit|close|delete|merge|comment|run|set|add` verbs. Those keep falling through to no-rule so `PERM_GATE_ENFORCE_AI=1` will bind them to ASK.

**`tests/test_perm_gate.py`** — two new test cases: `test_gh_readonly_surface_is_green` (21 read-only commands assert ALLOW/GREEN) and `test_gh_mutating_verbs_fall_through_to_ai_tier` (19 mutating commands assert no static verdict, including both `gh api -X POST` and `-X DELETE` to lock the wildcard out of static-allow).

The existing `\bdeploy\b` ASK pattern already catches `gh workflow run deploy.yml` — bonus correctness the test surfaced.
Starting Phase 1 — gathering branch state, diff, and tracking ticket.

**Where**: `bridge-cse_01BajQ2XB1Apigua3dTcogpU` — supervisor-managed bridge worktree (locked). Per [[project-bridge-worktree-close]], delivery here **switches the branch back, not `worktree remove`**.

**Branch state**:

**What this thread delivered**: addressed the loose end from the parent perm-gate thread — static-allow only covered `gh pr|issue|project view|list|status`, leaving `gh project item-list`, `gh pr checks/diff`, `gh search`, etc. in the no-rule path. Expanded the curated read-only `gh` surface (8 lines, conservative — no `gh api`, no mutating verbs). Added two tests (21 read-only commands assert ALLOW/GREEN; 19 mutating commands assert no static verdict). Discovered as a bonus that `gh workflow run deploy.yml` already gets caught by the existing `deploy` ASK pattern.

**Tracking ticket**: ⚠️ none claimed for this thread. The work is a direct follow-up to **ai-harness#25** (perm-gate follow-ups: tune lists, ENFORCE_AI, manager-ui) per memory. Two options for closing:

**Tests**: ran `python3 -m unittest tests.test_perm_gate` after the last edit. 61/61 green. Python-only — no Docker requirement (that's FamilyFund-specific).
